name: Slate

spine.record: a page in a tree in a container

description: A self-hosted product-planning workspace that turns evidence-backed briefs into reviewed execution plans.
scope: One business, one shared workspace, equal invited operators.

capabilities.description: A buyer-configured owner identity plate at the public root with a sign-in action and an optional static credit.
One configurable workspace with equal operators, authenticated links, a state-derived overview, and visible sign-in and invitation mail delivery.
Durable save status, visible failures, revision conflicts, idempotent mutations, honest offline state, and a defined text format.
A revision identifier on every planning record, readable history with differences, and restore.
Structured brief capture, shaping, readiness, plan creation, drift review, and archive lifecycle.
Fast, fresh global retrieval across every planning record, with links that survive rename, move, and archive.
Budgeted, source-aware AI proposals with review-before-mutation, provenance, and visible failure.
One importer per incumbent this seed replaces, each tested against an export that product itself produced, with a report of what did not map.
Complete export, referential restore, visible jobs, and rebuilt search.

nonGoals: Multiple workspaces, multi-tenancy, roles, permission levels, private records, guests, or public share links.
User-defined databases, formulas, rollups, sites, forms, embeds, or a generic file drive.
Slack, Jira, Asana, GitHub, calendar, CRM, or other external application sync.
Native mobile apps, real-time co-editing, shared cursors, presence, CRDT merge, or offline browsing and editing.
Autonomous AI mutations or uncited AI statements presented as facts.

externals.why: The supported deployment target supplies Worker compute, D1 records and search, R2 files, and Queues jobs; there is no owned primitive underneath it to fall back to.
Magic-link sign-in and operator invitations require outbound email, which Cloudflare's owned primitives do not send.
Optional research, synthesis, and plan proposals require model inference and optional provider web search, which no Cloudflare primitive in this deployment provides.
data: explicitly selected brief fields and evidence excerpts
the record identifiers needed for the run

env.name: APP_URL
env.why: Canonical deployment URL used in sign-in links.

env.name: MAIL_FROM
env.why: Verified sender for sign-in and invitations.

env.name: AI_ENABLED
env.why: Makes intentional AI disablement distinct from missing configuration.

env.name: AI_MODEL
env.why: Pins the model used and recorded by AI runs.

deploy.notes: The root is a public owner identity plate and /signin begins authentication. `/` is matched exactly and opens nothing beneath it, so a matcher compares it for equality rather than with `pathname.startsWith('/')`, which would admit every route. `/api/auth/` and `/assets/` end in a slash and are true prefixes covering the declared auth flow and the static assets; `/signin` and `/health` are exact. All workspace data endpoints and /app require a session.

limits.note: Every value here is a bootstrap estimate. The load test replaces them and rewrites this status; contract times are p95 at these values.

accessibility.status: target until the automated and manual audit runs against the ported app

operatingCost.status: estimated on 2026-08-31, not measured against a running deployment
operatingCost.assumptions: Up to 10 active operators, 2000 briefs, 4 GB of evidence, and moderate search and queue use.
operatingCost.cloudflarePerMonth: 0 while the deployment stays inside the Workers Free entitlements; Workers Paid is not the default for this seed.
operatingCost.workersPaidRequiredAt: Any of 100000 Worker requests/day, 10 ms CPU in an invocation, 5000000 D1 rows read/day, 100000 D1 rows written/day, 5 GB D1 storage, 10000 Queue operations/day, or a sixth Cron trigger.
